turns.q: How long will delivery take, roughly?
turns.replyTail:
Orders typically leave the warehouse within 2 business days when they don’t include a pre-order or custom piece.

Once shipped, Priority Shipping usually takes 2 to 7 business days for domestic deliveries. International deliveries usually take 15 to 20 business days. These timeframes start from the shipment date and can be extended by weather, holidays, or customs clearance 💖
